units.source_text: 然而只要阿笑的恋人给她寄一张明信片，她就会立刻赶到恋人身边。

en.t: Yet whenever Axiao's lover sent her a single postcard, she would immediately hurry to his side.

units.source_text: 她又坐火车又乘马车，还得避人耳目，躲在黑暗的竹林子里……

en.t: She would take the train and then a horse carriage, and still had to avoid people's eyes, hiding in the dark bamboo grove...

units.source_text: 尽管如此，她还是想要这笔“长途跋涉”的钱。

en.t: Even so, she still wanted the money for that long, hard journey.

units.source_text: 也许她这样做不是为了钱，而是有一股难以想象的热情，驱使她跑十里夜路前来卖身吧。

en.t: Perhaps she did it not for the money, but because some unimaginable passion drove her to run ten li through the night to come and sell herself.

units.source_text: 就如同传说中的女郎遨游大海去跟情人幽会一样……

en.t: Just like the woman in legend who crossed the vast sea to meet her lover in secret...
